recent.text: Thank you, Senator Krueger. This question is for Ashley. Thank you all for being here. It's always dangerous when you come in at the very end and throw out a question. But Ashley, I hear from small businesses across my district all the time about the challenges of doing business in New York State, whether it's the costly mandates that are pushed down on them, including the all-electric mandates…
